resources.string: Detects when you tap Copy, so the copied text can be sent to your own PC on the same WiFi. It does not read screen content and sends nothing anywhere else.
No WiFi — connect to the same WiFi as the PC
Looking for the PC on this WiFi…
The PC removed this phone — pair again
This phone has no WiFi address
Android 10+: turn on Accessibility for automatic phone → PC copy. If it is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"): Settings → Apps → Clipboard Bridge → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

How to use:
• PC → phone: Ctrl+C on PC, then paste on the phone.
• Phone → PC: copy on the phone, then Ctrl+V on PC.
• Also: select text → “Send to PC”, Share → Clipboard Bridge, the notification button, or the Quick Settings tile.
• If copying stops after a while (Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Samsung): allow Autostart and lock the app in Recents.
1. Open Clipboard Bridge V1 on the PC (same WiFi/router).\n2. Pick your PC below (or type its IP, shown in the PC window).\n3. Type the 6-digit PIN shown on the PC and tap Pair.
Searching every address on this WiFi…
No PC found automatically. Type the PC IP below.
Not working? Check: same WiFi/router; the PC app is open; when the PC asked for firewall permission you pressed Yes; VPN on the phone is off.
PC found: %1$s ✔ Now type the PIN and tap Pair.
Paired with %1$s ✔ Now just copy — the rest is automatic.
Select a PC or type its IP address.
Wrong PIN. Type the PIN currently shown on the PC.
Too many wrong PINs. Wait %1$d seconds.
The PC refused the connection — is Clipboard Bridge V1 open on the PC?
No answer from the PC — firewall blocking, or the phone is on a different WiFi.
This IP cannot be reached — the phone is on a different network.
